Each nonpivot moves line->C (rank5), contributes four actual weighted ADDs to the accumulators, then C->hub (rank3). It remains original q_N.
Four pivots move line->C. Four owned snapshots copy their original values at C.

Each pivot moves C->its assigned receiver facet (rank2), adds S_i to that receiver's stationary facet collector, then facet->hub (rank1).
At hub subtract the A_N q_N contributions using real nonpivot raw fields. Snapshot the four remaining A_I q_I rows, zero the pivot destinations and emit every nonzero inverse entry. Clear snapshots.
The eight frame donors move directly line->hub. At boundary2018 all104 donor originals are q at hub, before any of the 520 retained E8 source ADDs.

regeneration.matrix_reconstruction: Integer E8 roots: for port bitset b, if weight3 and bit8 present, a_k=2*[k in b]; if weight3 without bit8, a_k=1 if k in b else -1. For weight7 let absent bits i<j: if j=8, a_k=1 at k=i and -1 elsewhere; else a_k=2*([k=i]-[k=j]). G_ij=a_i dot a_j. Ordinary correction coefficient is -G_ij/8 for i!=j. Use exact fractions.
